R. Q. 1 صَبْصَبَهُ (assumed tropical:) He annihilated it, caused it to pass away, or did away with it; (M, K; *) namely, a thing. (M.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) He dispersed it, or scattered it: (K:) he (a man) dispersed, or scattered, it, namely, an army, or property or wealth. (AA, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
